title: Core alterations: bodices, trousers, jeans and gowns

say: Core alterations: bodices, trousers, jeans and gowns.

This is the heart of the course: the alterations clients bring every week.

say: The beginner's mistake is to take it all out at the side seams. That pulls them forward or back, and makes darts point the wrong way.

panel.heading: Share the reduction
left: All of it from the side seams
right: Side seams and darts share it

say: A professional shares the reduction between seams and darts, so the garment keeps its original shape, only smaller. Stitch each dart leg 0.5 cm further in, and the dart removes 1 cm more.

panel.heading: Share the reduction
left: All of it from the side seams
right: Side seams and darts share it

say: For example, Zainab, a nurse in Abuja, has lost weight. Her bodice waist is 86 cm, and with about 4 cm of ease the target is 80. So 6 cm must come out.

panel.heading: Zainab's lined dress: remove 6 cm
items: Waist 86 cm, target 80: remove 6 cm
Two seams in 1 cm each: 4 cm
Two back darts 1 cm more each: 2 cm
Skirt and lining change by the same 6 cm

say: Move the right side seam and the left zip seam in 1 cm each, tapering to nothing at the underarm. That removes 4 cm. The zip sits in a seam you are changing, so it is removed and re-set.

panel.heading: Zainab's lined dress: remove 6 cm
items: Waist 86 cm, target 80: remove 6 cm
Two seams in 1 cm each: 4 cm
Two back darts 1 cm more each: 2 cm
Skirt and lining change by the same 6 cm

say: Make each of the two back darts take 1 cm more. That is 2 cm. Total, 6 cm.

panel.heading: Zainab's lined dress: remove 6 cm
items: Waist 86 cm, target 80: remove 6 cm
Two seams in 1 cm each: 4 cm
Two back darts 1 cm more each: 2 cm
Skirt and lining change by the same 6 cm

say: The skirt waist must also become 80 cm, so the waist seam matches, and the lining is altered the same way so it does not pull.

panel.heading: Zainab's lined dress: remove 6 cm
items: Waist 86 cm, target 80: remove 6 cm
Two seams in 1 cm each: 4 cm
Two back darts 1 cm more each: 2 cm

say: Tack first, and fit again before you sew. Never trim the allowance below about 1.5 cm, so the dress can be let out again later.

panel.heading: Zainab's lined dress: remove 6 cm
items: Waist 86 cm, target 80: remove 6 cm
Two seams in 1 cm each: 4 cm
Two back darts 1 cm more each: 2 cm
Skirt and lining change by the same 6 cm
panel.rule: Tack and fit before you sew. Leave 1.5 to 2 cm of allowance.

say: Keep your fingers at least a finger's width from the needle, and pull pins out just before the needle reaches them. Switch off at the wall before changing the needle or the foot, and unplug the machine and iron when you leave the room.

panel.heading: At the machine and iron
items: Fingers a finger's width from the needle
Never sew over pins
Switch off at the wall to change needle or foot
Unplug machine and iron when you leave

say: Tailored trousers are made to be altered at the centre-back seam. To slim a leg, take equally from the inside and outside seams, to keep the crease centred.

panel.heading: Tapering a trouser leg
items: Inseam and outseam share it equally
Each seam moves a quarter of the reduction
Knee 50 to 46: move each seam 1 cm
Hem 46 to 38: move each seam 2 cm

say: Two seams with two layers each means each seam moves a quarter of the total.

panel.heading: Tapering a trouser leg
items: Inseam and outseam share it equally
Each seam moves a quarter of the reduction
Knee 50 to 46: move each seam 1 cm
Hem 46 to 38: move each seam 2 cm

say: For example, Chika's leg is 50 cm at the knee and 46 at the hem. She wants 46 and 38. So each seam moves 1 cm at the knee and 2 cm at the hem, blending back at mid-thigh. Check her foot still passes through.

say: Clients love the faded factory hem on their jeans. Suppose she wants them 5 cm shorter.

panel.heading: Keep the original hem
items: Mark the new length in her usual shoes
Fold up half the amount: 5 cm needs 2.5
Sew just below the original hem band
Trim to 1 cm, neaten, fold down, press

say: Fold the hem up by half the amount, 2.5 cm. The fold has two layers, so it uses up 5 cm of length.

panel.heading: Keep the original hem
items: Mark the new length in her usual shoes
Fold up half the amount: 5 cm needs 2.5
Sew just below the original hem band
Trim to 1 cm, neaten, fold down, press

say: With a zipper foot and strong thread matched to the denim, sew all round just below the original hem band.

panel.heading: Keep the original hem
items: Mark the new length in her usual shoes
Fold up half the amount: 5 cm needs 2.5
Sew just below the original hem band
Trim to 1 cm, neaten, fold down, press

say: Trim the inside to about 1 cm, neaten it, fold the hem down and press. Compare both legs.

panel.heading: Keep the original hem

say: Gowns are high value and high risk. Photograph any stain, pull or missing bead in front of the client, and write it on the job card.

panel.heading: Order of work: top to hem
items: Photograph any damage before you accept
Shoulders first, then bust and bodice
Waist and hips, then the zip
Hem and lining last, lining a little shorter

say: Work from the top. Taking up the shoulders 1.5 cm lifts the bust shaping and waist by about 1.5 cm. Check the armhole does not cut into her arm.

panel.heading: Order of work: top to hem
items: Photograph any damage before you accept
Shoulders first, then bust and bodice
Waist and hips, then the zip
Hem and lining last, lining a little shorter

say: The hem is always last, because every change above can change the length. Finish the lining about 2.5 cm shorter so it never peeps out, and never cut off a scalloped lace border.

panel.heading: Order of work: top to hem
items: Photograph any damage before you accept
Shoulders first, then bust and bodice
Waist and hips, then the zip
Hem and lining last, lining a little shorter

say: For example, Kemi's lace gown needs shoulders raised, the bodice taken in and the hem shortened, with a scalloped border re-applied by hand.

panel.heading: Kemi's aso-ebi gown in 12 days
items: Estimate each task in minutes
Total: 400 minutes, 6 hours 40
Two fittings in the plan
Collection two days before the wedding

say: Adding every task gives 400 minutes, which is 6 hours 40 minutes. Put that in your weekly schedule so you do not accept too many other jobs.

panel.heading: Kemi's aso-ebi gown in 12 days
items: Estimate each task in minutes
Total: 400 minutes, 6 hours 40
Two fittings in the plan
Collection two days before the wedding

say: Plan backwards from the event, with two fittings, and collection two days before the wedding. If there is a power cut or she changes her shoes, you still have time.

panel.heading: Kemi's aso-ebi gown in 12 days
items: Estimate each task in minutes
Total: 400 minutes, 6 hours 40
Two fittings in the plan
Collection two days before the wedding
panel.rule: Finish occasion wear at least two days before the event.

say: To remember. Share a reduction between seams and darts, and change the skirt to match. Each trouser seam moves a quarter. For an original hem, fold up half. On gowns, shoulders first, hem last, and finish early.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Share a reduction between seams and darts
Change the skirt by the same amount
Each trouser seam moves a quarter
Original hem: fold up half the amount
Gowns: shoulders first, hem last, finish early
